definitions.explanation: The chemical, physical, and biological characteristics of water, typically evaluated to determine its suitability for drinking, swimming, agriculture, or environmental health.

examples.japanese: {水質|すいしつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct a water quality test.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水質|すいしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良好|りょうこう}→良好：13954_ryoukou⟧だ。
examples.english: The water quality of this river is good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水質|すいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}している→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
examples.english: The water quality in the surrounding area has deteriorated due to factory wastewater.

notes:
Composed of {水|すい} (water) and ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality). A key term in environmental science and public health. Water quality monitoring is an important part of environmental protection in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水質|すいしつ}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: water quality testing
- {水質|すいしつ}⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: water pollution
- {水質|すいしつ}⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: water quality standards
- {水質|すいしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: water quality deteriorates
- {水質|すいしつ}⟦{改善|かいぜん}→改善：00144_kaizen⟧: water quality improvement

RELATED WORDS:
- {水質|すいしつ}{汚濁|おだく}: water contamination — a more technical term for water pollution
- {浄水|じょうすい}: water purification / purified water
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧: sewage — wastewater
- ⟦{飲料水|いんりょうすい}→飲料水：15275_inryousui⟧: drinking water
